subject: Opsly upgrade & bundle orchestration — timing, credits, and rollback
messages:
From: Raj Patel <raj@opsly.io>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Question on upgrading now + feature bundle options

Hey Marcus,

Quick one — Opsly is reviewing whether to move off our Compact plan to a higher throughput tier (we're leaning toward Performance+Dedicated). We have ~6 months left on the current term and wanted to know:

- Can we upgrade mid-term and get credit for the remaining Compact months? If so, is that a pro-rated credit applied on the next invoice or a one-time account credit?
- If we add Dedicated capacity and the Private deployment add-on, can those start immediately or do they need a fixed lead time?
- We're also interested in bundling the Dedicated pool with a 10% add-on discount for a 12-month commitment — is that something you can support?

Attaching our internal timeline briefly (we'll forward procurement details once I get a sense of cost). Can you send a quote and a quick choice of two upgrade paths (fast start vs. staged ramp)?

Thanks,
Raj Patel
Head of Platform Engineering, Opsly
raj@opsly.io

[attachment: opsly-timeline.pdf (stub)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Raj Patel <raj@opsly.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Question on upgrading now + feature bundle options

Raj — really appreciate the context. Short answers up front, then options: 

1) Credits: we can offer a pro-rated credit for the unused portion of Compact. Standard practice is to apply it as an on-account credit that reduces your next invoice; for larger commits we can also convert to an upfront one-time credit on the signed amendment.

2) Dedicated + Private: Dedicated pools typically require a 10–14 business day provisioning window for reserved GPUs and network setup for Private (VPC). We can fast-track to ~7 business days for an expedited fee if you need immediate capacity.

3) Bundled discount: We can do a 10% bundle discount for a 12-month commit on top of the standard tier pricing, subject to an approval on the committed spend.

Options I recommend:
- Fast Start (Option A): Immediate upgrade effective at signature + expedited provisioning. Pro-rated credit applied to next invoice. Dedicated pool provisioned in 7 business days (expedite fee applies).
- Staged Ramp (Option B): Upgrade to Performance tier immediately, add Dedicated pool at month boundary (no expedite fee). Pro-rated credit applied monthly across remaining term.

I've attached a quick quote and a mutual action plan draft. Can you confirm: expected average tokens/day at peak and preferred go-live date? I'll loop in Ben to confirm provisioning lead times and Lauren for legal/contract mechanics.

Cheers,
Marcus Lin
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai

Attachments: Opsly-upgrade-quote.pdf (stub), Opsly-MAP-v1.xlsx (stub)

Thanks Marcus — good options. A few specifics from our side:

- Current plan: Compact, auto-renewing. Term ends 2027-03-01 (so ~5.5 months left actually).
- Usage: 3–4M tokens/day average, spikes to ~12M tokens/day during batch jobs.
- Desired: Performance tier + a small Dedicated pool (2 x A100-equivalent), Private control plane is optional but preferred for compliance.
- Procurement: Celeste (cc'd) handles PO/contracting — timeline is tight: we'd like to have higher throughput within the next 3 weeks if possible.

Questions:
- If we do Option A with expedited provisioning, can the Dedicated pool be temporarily burstable before reserved pool is fully provisioned? We might accept a short-term burst to keep performance.
- If we later decide to downgrade back to Performance (non-dedicated) at renewal, are there penalties or is it allowed with 30 days' notice?

If you can get me a quote with (1) expedited lead + one-off expedite fee, and (2) standard lead, we'll review with procurement.

—Raj

Hi Raj & Celeste — looping in legal/ops next steps so we can hit your desired window. Summary & commitments: 

- Pricing/credits: We will apply a pro-rated on-account credit for unused Compact months. For the deal size here, we can convert that to a one-time credit on the signed amendment if Opsly prefers that treatment.
- Provisioning/timing: Standard Dedicated provisioning = 10–14 business days. We can expedite to 7 business days for an expedite fee of $5,000 (one-time). Temporary burst access is available via our Hosted API capacity for up to 2 weeks while Dedicated pool is finalized; that would be billed at metered rates.
- Downgrade rules: Downgrades to a non-dedicated Performance tier are permitted only at renewal with 30 days' written notice. No early-termination penalty — just the standard committed term math (remaining committed spend still applies if you signed a 12-month reserved commitment).
- Bundle discount: 10% off Dedicated + Performance list if you sign a 12-month commitment; discount shown on the attached quote.

Next steps:
1) Celeste — let us know if Opsly prefers the credit applied as "invoice reduction" or a "one-time amendment credit".
2) Marcus & Ben will update the quote to include expedited provisioning and the short-term Hosted burst option.
3) I'll send an amendment + DocuSign link once we have the chosen path.

We prepared a draft amendment and a signed-terms checklist; DocuSign link will be here when ready: https://docusign.com/DocuSign-Link-OPS-0915

Thanks — happy to jump on a 30-min call tomorrow to finalize.

Best,
